title: Uses Report (CSV)
summary: Exports the project's unit-dependency data as a CSV file
intro: Read this when you need the uses graph outside the IDE, in a spreadsheet or another tool: it exports the unit-dependency data of the project as a CSV file.

steps: Choose drag-lint > Uses & Dependencies > Uses Report (CSV)...
Pick the CSV file to write

surfaces.usage: drag-lint uses-report --output <out.csv> [--db ...] [--depth N] [--include-external] [--all-sources] [--name <pattern>] (--name is a substring on the unit stem; one that matches NO source unit exits 2 with an ERROR and writes nothing, like outline)
help: drag-lint uses-report --output|--out <out.csv> [--db ...] [--depth N] [--include-external] [--all-sources] [--name <pattern>]   (--name is a substring on the unit stem; one that matches NO source unit exits 2 with an ERROR and writes nothing, like outline)

questions.ask: How do I export the project's unit dependencies to a spreadsheet?
How do I limit the report to some units?
